interstitial.why: Fires once when Prints (gallery) opens, after the push (mobile/lib/features/studio/studio_screen.dart:194-199 openPrints -> AglAds.onTransition()). That is a natural break between creating and browsing, not mid-task; agl_ads caps it (warm-up 2 transitions, min 3 min, packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ads.dart:22,26). Creative app, not finance/health/payments.

native.why: The only content list is the user's own prints, laid out as a SliverGrid of image tiles (gallery_screen.dart:209-216, maxCrossAxisExtent 240, aspect 0.74). Google's native templates are full-width rows (small ~90-120dp) or ~320dp media cards (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ad_native.dart:20-22); squeezed into a print-shaped grid cell it would either break or read like one of the user's prints. Fitting it would mean splitting the grid into chunks with full-width rows between them - a layout rework, not a natural slot. The gallery already carries the banner at its foot (gallery_screen.dart:228). Studio's ListView.builder (studio_screen.dart:811-813) is a prompt-match picker, not a feed.

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none in-app. Limits that exist: upstream Pollinations rate-limit pause mobile/lib/features/studio/studio_controller.dart:116 (rateLimitPauseSeconds = 30) and gallery storage cap mobile/lib/services/history_repository.dart:24 (defaultMaxEntries = 200)
rewarded.why: No honest non-essential extra to give. The 30 s pause is the free Pollinations.ai tier's own limit (spec AGStudio.md:88-89; studio_controller.dart:291-302 starts the cooldown only after a 402/429); watching an ad cannot make the upstream accept a request sooner, so 'watch an ad to skip the wait' would be false. The 200-print cap is a disk-growth guard that already skips starred/proof-sheet prints (history_repository.dart:29-31,148-156), not a quota to sell. Proof-sheet export has no limit (proof_sheet_exporter.dart: no limit/quota found by grep). No IAP or premium tier (grep in_app_purchase/premium/pro in lib and pubspec: none).
